Demand and revenue are unverified.

items.title: No authorized payment route; founder picks Apify (A) or a Gumroad seller account (B)
items.detail: commercial_paths.collection is NOT_IMPLEMENTED and the treasury is UNFUNDED. Option B is now concrete (products/research/platform-managed-settlement-fit.json, verdict PURSUE_IF, observed 2026-11-05). Gumroad documents Canada CAD bank payouts and acts as merchant of record (it collects sales tax). Fees are 10%+$0.50 direct or 30% via Discover. Payout needs a USD 100 minimum and a 7-day hold, with Stripe KYC on the founder. Smallest founder step for B: create or designate a GlobalLand Gumroad seller account in the founder's name and add a CAD bank account. Share only the public profile URL; agents then prepare one product package for independent review, and the founder uploads it. Option A is unchanged: an Apify config plus a 0600 credential (NO-APIFY-ACCESS) unlocks 3 tested Actors with PPE billing. Either option still needs a payout-attestation or reconciliation path before Treasury can verify revenue. Agents will not create accounts, accept terms or take orders.
items.expected_gain: Turns any observed request or usage into collectable, platform-settled payment. No demand or revenue is established now.
